estimand: Mechanical interaction and caller-transformation difference between a known-contract read/compose/write path and the source-defined prepare/write path on exactly twelve deterministic isolated fixture tasks.

execution.isolation: Each task-strategy member receives a fresh temporary Git worktree and one mechanically valid target fact; no mutable state is shared between members.
execution.known_contract_minimal: read-fact-objects plus official write route: exactly two Helper calls.
execution.known_contract_cold: general capabilities discovery plus read-fact-objects plus official write route: exactly three Helper calls.
execution.prepare: prepare-fact-object-update plus its returned official write route: exactly two Helper calls.
execution.fixture_instrumentation: Stale branches append one byte sequence directly between preparation and the official write attempt; this setup mutation is not a Helper or strategy shell roundtrip and is compared byte-for-byte before and after the official failure.

metrics.request_chars: Sum of compact JSON request characters at the in-process Helper service boundary.
metrics.caller_transformations: Count of frozen named caller-side composition steps, not a claim about cognitive effort.
metrics.invalids: Every stale, no-op, or all-null-signature branch must fail without an official-route write.

privacy.artifact_boundary: Retain labels, hashes, counts, booleans, unavailable markers, and aggregates only. Never retain raw prompts, full facts, authorization, signatures, absolute paths, session identifiers, transcripts, or secrets.

evidence_boundary.allowed: Deterministic isolated fixture integration evidence for the frozen tasks and service boundary.
evidence_boundary.minimal_claim: Known-contract baseline 2 to prepare 2 is parity only.
evidence_boundary.cold_claim: Cold-discovery baseline 3 to prepare 2 is one mechanical Helper-call reduction.
evidence_boundary.unavailable: Host receipt, provider tokens, cache use, wall latency, and queue latency unless actually observed.
evidence_boundary.forbidden_claims: No real-task, representative, fresh-agent, host-delivery, causal, or broad service-quality conclusion.
